testcase.name: Scenario: Home and End leave the focused panel row unchanged: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-visibility-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-visibility/ribbon-panel-visibility.feature:300:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Home and End leave the focused panel row unchanged ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active ✔ And the full top-docked 3D Model ribbon is visible ✔ And the direct panel selector is open with Create focused and checked ✔ When the user presses Home ✔ Then Create remains focused and checked ✔ And the panel selector remains open ✔ When the user presses End ✔ Then Create remains focused and checked ✔ And the panel selector remains open ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the panel selector closes
